verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's official hosted MCP server, documented as Beta, lets a user drive the product through natural-language prompts in an AI-assisted IDE such as Claude Code. Through it the user can query payment statuses, issue refunds, void payments, create and manage payment links, and get guided onboarding, with OAuth sign-in tied to the Dashboard account. It counts as partial because it is Beta, needs a third-party AI client, and covers only a slice of operations. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface in the Dashboard, natural-language coverage beyond payments, refunds, voids and links (e.g. fraud rules, reports, payouts, platforms), GA status, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.
